editorial.title: This Week's Essential Midnight Releases
editorial.summary: Five records and one show shaping the mood this week.
editorial.body: Playlisted's editorial team highlights nocturnal releases with strong atmosphere — from Nova Lane's Afterglow Transit to Hex Wave's Dark Matter and Jade Mirror's late-night R&B sketches.

editorial.title: New Faces: May's Breakthrough Artists
editorial.summary: Hex Wave, Jade Mirror, Static Bloom, and Pulse Drift — four debuts worth your full attention.
editorial.body: Four new creators launched this month and each one brings something distinct. Hex Wave works in heavyweight electronics and trap architecture. Jade Mirror writes soul from the inside out. Static Bloom's guitars are understated and precise. Pulse Drift builds for the floor.
